fileTitle: File:World War I veteran Joseph Ambrose, 86, at the dedication day parade for the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in 1982.jpg
creator: Department of Defense. Defense Audiovisual Agency; Scene Camera Operator: Mickey Sanborn
alt: World War I veteran Joseph Ambrose at a 1982 memorial dedication parade, shown as a historical photograph.
description: Joseph Ambrose , an 86-year-old World War I veteran, attends the dedication day parade for the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in 1982. Wearing a doughboy uniform like the ones used during the war, he is holding an American flag. It covered the casket of his son Clement, who was killed in the Korean War .
caption: World War I veteran Joseph Ambrose at a 1982 memorial dedication parade, shown as a historical photograph.
